0022600174.text: The Wizards (4-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East, on a two-game winning streak) host the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, 7th in the East, on a one-game winning streak) in Washington's eighth game of the season. Washington is 2-1 at home and Atlanta is 3-2 on the road, and the Wizards are missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), Reece Beekman (out, shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip, pinched nerve), while Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Bilal Coulibaly (illness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Jalen Johnson (ankle) day-to-day and a game-time decision, and the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, most recently a 126-96 defeat in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
